notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: Messages, mentions, new email, reminders and meetings will show up here.
notifications.desktopPrompt: Get desktop notifications when Zentico is in the background?
notifications.desktopBlocked: Desktop notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
notifications.desktopUnsupported: This browser doesn't support desktop notifications.

page.title: Notifications
page.intro: Choose what reaches you and how. Everything still collects in the bell at the top.
page.chatHint: Direct messages, groups, replies in your threads and mentions.
page.channelMentionsOnly: In channels, only mentions and replies
page.channelMentionsOnlyHint: Turn off to be notified of every message in channels you've joined.
page.meetingsHint: When someone starts a meeting in one of your conversations.
page.mailHint: New messages in your Inbox. Only sender and subject are shown.
page.calendarHint: Reminders before events (their own alerts, or 10 minutes) and new invitations.
page.claudeHint: When a command finishes, fails or needs your confirmation, if you're not in that meeting.
page.desktopHint: When Zentico is in the background or you're in another section.
page.soundHint: A short chime for direct messages, mentions and meetings starting.
page.dndHint: Pauses desktop notifications, pop-ups and sounds. Notifications still collect in the bell.
